usedFor: Shopify holds the orders, and Hive receives a task through “Create Action for Workspace” after an “Order Cancelled”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create Action for Workspace” in Hive
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order needs someone to look at it, so Hive gets a task with a scheduled date.

watchOut: “Create Message” posts into a Hive workspace group, so check the group before you point “New Product” at it.
